Rime Grip

Frost climbs their limbs like fingers closing around a wrist.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Knowledge

Target / range / shape: One visible creature within 5 squares

Proposed NPC defense attribute: Agility.

- Weak: 3 cold damage. - Standard: 3 cold damage; Slowed 1. - Strong: 5 cold damage; Slowed 1 and Freezing 1.

Duration: Instant

Equipment / acquisition: None.

---

Tier / minimum level: 1 · DP: 2 · Requirements to learn: Frost 1

Type: Magic / Attack

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: rime-grip
